title: zebRabox: Processing and Visualization of ZebraBox Behavioural Data
description: zebRabox is an R package and Shiny application that turns raw exports of the ViewPoint ZebraBox high-throughput behavioural chamber into clean, merged, analysis-ready datasets and figures. It provides randomized plate plan generation, import of tracking and quantization data recorded under light/dark or vibration/rest protocols, period assignment and data removal steps, visualizations, percentage tables and statistical tests, both through a graphical interface and as standalone R functions.
